verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents alert disposition (docs-23) and an automatic audit trail of all work (docs-14), with decisions described as defensible (docs-22). Alerts are grouped into cases that can be updated via API (docs-1, docs-2), and approval workflows exist (docs-19). There is no explicit documentation of marking an alert as a false positive, or of reopening or overriding a closed decision; the auto-opening pending review (docs-16) is periodic re-review, not a reopen. Missing for 10: explicit false-positive resolution flow, documented reopen/override of a closed decision, evidence that overrides are captured in the audit record, independent or hands-on corroboration.
